method.description: Lexical/rendering divergence indicator; not a doctrinal truth score or majority vote.
method.normalization: case, punctuation, footnote markers, and common KJV archaisms normalized
method.public_ranking_guard: minimum 8 POB tokens and three length-compatible references
method.public_headline: POB novelty × square-root(reference consensus); documented risk is excluded

sources.bsb: Berean Standard Bible (Public Domain / CC0). bereanbible.com.
sources.asv: American Standard Version (1901; Public Domain). ebible.org/asv/.
sources.brenton: Brenton's translation of the Septuagint (1844/1851; Public Domain). ebible.org/eng-Brenton/.
sources.kjv: King James Version, ebible.org 2006 transcription (Public Domain in US).

pob.text: Simeon Peter[a], a slave and apostle of Jesus the Messiah[d][c][b], to those who have obtained a faith as precious as ours in the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus the Messiah:

spob.text:
From Simeon Peter, a slave of Jesus the Messiah and one of his apostles.

To those who have received a faith just as precious as ours[a] in[b] the righteousness of Jesus the Messiah, our God and Savior:[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours:
public_domain_references.web: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:
public_domain_references.asv: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and [the] Saviour Jesus Christ:
public_domain_references.kjv: Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ:

pob.text: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord[a][b].

spob.text: May grace and peace increase for you through your knowledge of God and Jesus our Lord.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
public_domain_references.web: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,
public_domain_references.asv: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;
public_domain_references.kjv: Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord,

pob.text: As his divine power has granted to us all things for life and godliness[a], through the knowledge of the one who called us by his own glory and excellence,

spob.text: As his divine power has given us everything we need for life and for living in a way that honors God, through knowing the one who called us by his own glory and excellence.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: His divine power has given us everything we need for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us by His own glory and excellence.
public_domain_references.web: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,
public_domain_references.asv: seeing that his divine power hath granted unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that called us by his own glory and virtue;
public_domain_references.kjv: According as his divine power hath given unto us all things that [pertain] unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that hath called us to glory and virtue:

pob.text: through which he has granted to us his precious and very great promises[a], so that through these you may become sharers in the divine nature[b], having escaped the corruption that is in the world because of sinful desire.

spob.text: Through these things, he has given us precious and very great promises. Through these promises, you may come to share in the divine nature,[a] after escaping the corruption in the world caused by sinful desire.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Through these He has given us His precious and magnificent promises, so that through them you may become partakers of the divine nature, now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires.
public_domain_references.web: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
public_domain_references.asv: whereby he hath granted unto us his precious and exceeding great promises; that through these ye may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these ye might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust.

pob.text: And for this very reason[a], making every effort, supply in your faith virtue, and in virtue knowledge[d][c][b],

spob.text: For this very reason, make every effort to supply your faith[a] with virtue[b], and your virtue with knowledge.

public_domain_references.bsb: For this very reason, make every effort to add to your faith virtue; and to virtue, knowledge;
public_domain_references.web: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply virtue; and in [your] virtue knowledge;
public_domain_references.kjv: And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge;

pob.text: and in knowledge[a], self-control; and in self-control, steadfastness; and in steadfastness, godliness[b],

spob.text: Add self-control to knowledge, steadfastness[a] to self-control, and godliness to steadfastness.

public_domain_references.bsb: and to knowledge, self-control; and to self-control, perseverance; and to perseverance, godliness;
public_domain_references.web: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;
public_domain_references.asv: and in [your] knowledge self-control; and in [your] self-control patience; and in [your] patience godliness;
public_domain_references.kjv: And to knowledge temperance; and to temperance patience; and to patience godliness;

pob.text: and in godliness[a], brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

spob.text: and to your life of devotion to God, add affection for fellow believers; and to that affection, add love.

public_domain_references.bsb: and to godliness, brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness, love.
public_domain_references.web: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.
public_domain_references.asv: and in [your] godliness brotherly kindness; and in [your] brotherly kindness love.
public_domain_references.kjv: And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness charity.

pob.text: For if these things are yours and are increasing[c][b][a], they keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

spob.text: If you have these qualities and they continue to grow, they will keep you from being ineffective or unfruitful in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

public_domain_references.bsb: For if you possess these qualities and continue to grow in them, they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in your knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.web: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.asv: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful unto the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: For if these things be in you, and abound, they make [you that ye shall] neither [be] barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

pob.text: For whoever lacks these things is blind[a], being shortsighted[b], having forgotten the cleansing of his former sins.

spob.text: Anyone who does not have these qualities is spiritually blind and sees only what is near.[a] He has forgotten that he was cleansed from his former sins.

public_domain_references.bsb: But whoever lacks these traits is nearsighted to the point of blindness, having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past sins.
public_domain_references.web: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
public_domain_references.asv: For he that lacketh these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.

pob.text: Therefore[a], brothers, be all the more diligent to make your calling and election sure, for if you do these things, you will certainly never stumble.

spob.text: Therefore, brothers,[a] make an even greater effort to show by your lives that God has called and chosen you. For if you practice these things, you will certainly never stumble.

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore, brothers, strive to make your calling and election sure. For if you practice these things you will never stumble,
public_domain_references.web: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore, brethren, give the more diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never stumble:
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if ye do these things, ye shall never fall:

pob.text: For in this way entry into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus the Messiah will be richly provided for you[a][b][c].

spob.text: For in this way, you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus the Messiah.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: and you will receive a lavish reception into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.web: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.asv: for thus shall be richly supplied unto you the entrance into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
public_domain_references.kjv: For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

pob.text: Therefore I will always be ready to remind you about these things[a], even though you know them and have been established in the present truth.

spob.text: So I intend to keep reminding you of these things, even though you already know them and are firmly grounded in the truth now present among you.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore I will always remind you of these things, even though you know them and are established in the truth you now have.
public_domain_references.web: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.
public_domain_references.asv: Wherefore I shall be ready always to put you in remembrance of these things, though ye know them, and are established in the truth which is with [you].
public_domain_references.kjv: Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though ye know [them], and be established in the present truth.

pob.text: But I consider it right[a], as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by way of reminder,

spob.text: But as long as I live in this tent,[a] I believe it is right to stir you up by reminding you.

public_domain_references.bsb: I think it is right to refresh your memory as long as I live in the tent of my body,
public_domain_references.web: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,
public_domain_references.asv: And I think it right, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting [you] in remembrance;

pob.text: knowing that the putting off of my tent is near[c][b][a], just as our Lord Jesus the Messiah made clear to me.

spob.text: I know that the time is near for me to lay aside my tent—this body—just as our Lord Jesus the Messiah made clear to me.

public_domain_references.bsb: because I know that this tent will soon be laid aside, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
public_domain_references.web: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.
public_domain_references.asv: knowing that the putting off of my tabernacle cometh swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ signified unto me.
public_domain_references.kjv: Knowing that shortly I must put off [this] my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath shewed me.

pob.text: And I will make every effort so that[a], after my departure, you may be able at any time to recall these things.

spob.text: And I will make every effort so that, after my departure, you can recall these things whenever you need to.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: And I will make every effort to ensure that after my departure, you will be able to recall these things at all times.
public_domain_references.web: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, I will give diligence that at every time ye may be able after my decease to call these things to remembrance.
public_domain_references.kjv: Moreover I will endeavour that ye may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance.

pob.text: For we did not make known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus the Messiah by following cleverly devised myths[b][a], but by becoming eyewitnesses of his majesty.

spob.text: We did not tell you about the power and coming[a] of our Lord Jesus the Messiah[b] on the basis of cleverly invented myths. Instead, we spoke as eyewitnesses: we had seen his majesty with our own eyes.

public_domain_references.bsb: For we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of His majesty.
public_domain_references.web: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
public_domain_references.asv: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.
public_domain_references.kjv: For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

pob.text: For when he received honor and glory from God the Father[a], such a voice was borne to him from the Majestic Glory: “This is my Son, my Beloved[c][b], in whom I am well pleased”—

spob.text: For he received honor and glory from God the Father when a voice was carried to him from the Majestic Glory.[a] The voice said, “This is my Son, my Beloved, in whom I am well pleased”—

public_domain_references.bsb: For He received honor and glory from God the Father when the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is My beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
public_domain_references.web: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”
public_domain_references.asv: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when there was borne such a voice to him by the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased:
public_domain_references.kjv: For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

pob.text: And we ourselves heard this voice brought from heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain[a].

spob.text: We ourselves heard this voice come from heaven when we were with Jesus on the holy mountain.

public_domain_references.bsb: And we ourselves heard this voice from heaven when we were with Him on the holy mountain.
public_domain_references.web: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.
public_domain_references.asv: and this voice we [ourselves] heard borne out of heaven, when we were with him in the holy mount.
public_domain_references.kjv: And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount.

pob.text: And we have the prophetic word more certain[a], to which you do well to pay attention as to a lamp shining in a dark place[b], until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.

spob.text: And the prophetic word has been confirmed even more.[a] You are right to pay close attention to it. It is like a lamp shining in a dark place until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt. And you will do well to pay attention to it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
public_domain_references.web: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,
public_domain_references.asv: And we have the word of prophecy [made] more sure; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day-star arise in your hearts:
public_domain_references.kjv: We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:

pob.text: knowing this first: that every prophecy of Scripture does not come about from one's own interpretation.

spob.text: First, understand this about every prophecy in Scripture: it does not come from a person’s own interpretation.

public_domain_references.bsb: Above all, you must understand that no prophecy of Scripture comes from one’s own interpretation.
public_domain_references.web: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.
public_domain_references.asv: knowing this first, that no prophecy of scripture is of private interpretation.
public_domain_references.kjv: Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.

pob.text: For prophecy was never brought forth by the will of man[c][b][a], but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.

spob.text: No prophecy ever originated in human will. Instead, people spoke from God as the Holy Spirit carried them along.

public_domain_references.bsb: For no such prophecy was ever brought forth by the will of man, but men spoke from God as they were carried along by the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.web: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.asv: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but men spake from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake [as they were] moved by the Holy Ghost.

pob.text: But false prophets also arose among the people[a], just as there will also be false teachers among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them[b], bringing swift destruction on themselves.

spob.text: But false prophets also arose among the people in the past. In the same way, false teachers will arise among you. They will secretly introduce teachings that lead to destruction,[a] even denying the Master who bought them.[b] They will bring swift destruction on themselves.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now there were also false prophets among the people, just as there will be false teachers among you. They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
public_domain_references.web: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.
public_domain_references.asv: But there arose false prophets also among the people, as among you also there shall be false teachers, who shall privily bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master that bought them, bringing upon themselves swift destruction.
public_domain_references.kjv: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.

pob.text: And many will follow their sensuality[c][b][a], and because of them the way of the truth will be blasphemed.

spob.text: Many will follow their shameless, unrestrained behavior. Because of them, the way of truth[a] will be spoken against.

public_domain_references.bsb: Many will follow in their depravity, and because of them the way of truth will be defamed.
public_domain_references.web: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.
public_domain_references.asv: And many shall follow their lascivious doings; by reason of whom the way of the truth shall be evil spoken of.
public_domain_references.kjv: And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of.

pob.text: And in greed they will exploit you with fabricated words. Their judgment from long ago is not idle[a], and their destruction is not asleep.

spob.text: In their greed, they will exploit you[a] with words they have made up. The judgment against them was set long ago and is not sitting idle. Their destruction is not asleep.

public_domain_references.bsb: In their greed, these false teachers will exploit you with deceptive words. The longstanding verdict against them remains in force, and their destruction does not sleep.
public_domain_references.web: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.
public_domain_references.asv: And in covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose sentence now from of old lingereth not, and their destruction slumbereth not.
public_domain_references.kjv: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.

pob.text: For if God did not spare angels when they sinned[a], but cast them into Tartarus and committed them to chains of gloom, to be kept for judgment[b],

spob.text: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but threw them into Tartarus[a] and handed them over to chains of gloom to be held for judgment,[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
public_domain_references.web: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;
public_domain_references.asv: For if God spared not angels when they sinned, but cast them down to hell, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;
public_domain_references.kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast [them] down to hell, and delivered [them] into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

pob.text: and if he did not spare the ancient world[a], but preserved Noah, an eighth person, a herald of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon a world of the ungodly[c][b],

spob.text: and if he did not spare the ancient world, but kept Noah safe—one of eight people[a] and one who publicly proclaimed righteousness—when he brought a flood on a world of ungodly people,

public_domain_references.bsb: if He did not spare the ancient world when He brought the flood on its ungodly people, but preserved Noah, a preacher of righteousness, among the eight;
public_domain_references.web: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,
public_domain_references.asv: and spared not the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood upon the world of the ungodly;
public_domain_references.kjv: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth [person], a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

pob.text: and if by reducing the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to ashes he condemned them to destruction[a], having made them an example for those who would be ungodly[b],

spob.text: and if he condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes and making them an example for people who would later live ungodly lives,

public_domain_references.bsb: if He condemned the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah to destruction, reducing them to ashes as an example of what is coming on the ungodly;
public_domain_references.web: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,
public_domain_references.asv: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, having made them an example unto those that should live ungodly;
public_domain_references.kjv: And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned [them] with an overthrow, making [them] an ensample unto those that after should live ungodly;

pob.text: and he rescued righteous Lot[c][b][a], who was being tormented by the sensual conduct of the lawless—

spob.text: And he rescued righteous Lot, who was being tormented by the shamelessly sensual way the lawless people lived—

public_domain_references.bsb: and if He rescued Lot, a righteous man distressed by the depraved conduct of the lawless
public_domain_references.web: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked
public_domain_references.asv: and delivered righteous Lot, sore distressed by the lascivious life of the wicked
public_domain_references.kjv: And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:

pob.text: for by what he saw and heard[a], that righteous man, living among them[c][b], was tormenting his righteous soul day after day with their lawless deeds—

spob.text: For while that righteous man lived among them, day after day he tormented his righteous soul because of their lawless deeds and what he saw and heard[a]—

public_domain_references.bsb: (for that righteous man, living among them day after day, was tormented in his righteous soul by the lawless deeds he saw and heard)—
public_domain_references.web: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),
public_domain_references.asv: (for that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] lawless deeds):
public_domain_references.kjv: (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed [his] righteous soul from day to day with [their] unlawful deeds;)

pob.text: then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trial[a], and to keep the unrighteous under punishment until the day of judgment[b],

spob.text: So the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from trials,[a] and how to keep unrighteous people under punishment until the day of judgment.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: if all this is so, then the Lord knows how to rescue the godly from trials and to hold the unrighteous for punishment on the day of judgment.
public_domain_references.web: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,
public_domain_references.asv: the Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptation, and to keep the unrighteous under punishment unto the day of judgment;
public_domain_references.kjv: The Lord knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished:

pob.text: especially those who go after the flesh in the desire for defilement and despise authority[a]. Bold, self-willed, they do not tremble as they blaspheme glorious ones[d][c][b],

spob.text: This is especially true of those who follow the flesh, craving what is impure, and who despise authority. They are bold and determined to have their own way. They do not tremble even as they speak evil of glorious beings.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Such punishment is specially reserved for those who indulge the corrupt desires of the flesh and despise authority. Bold and self-willed, they are unafraid to slander glorious beings.
public_domain_references.web: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,
public_domain_references.asv: but chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise dominion. Daring, self-willed, they tremble not to rail at dignities:
public_domain_references.kjv: But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Presumptuous [are they], selfwilled, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities.

pob.text: whereas angels[a], though greater in might and power[b], do not bring a slanderous judgment against them.

spob.text: Even angels, though they are stronger and more powerful, do not bring a slanderous judgment against them.[a][b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Yet not even angels, though greater in strength and power, dare to bring such slanderous charges against them before the Lord.
public_domain_references.web: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.
public_domain_references.asv: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, bring not a railing judgment against them before the Lord.
